author: jamieson
title: Commentary Critical and Explanatory on the Whole Bible: Genesis
edition: Robert Jamieson, A. R. Fausset and David Brown, Commentary Critical and Explanatory on the Whole Bible (1871), CCEL edition; Genesis by Robert Jamieson

rights.worldwide: public domain: Jamieson died in 1880, Fausset in 1910 and Brown in 1897; CCEL's transcription follows an unnamed printing

notes: Known as "Jamieson, Fausset and Brown". One excerpt per numbered verse note, with the bold lemmas that follow it on the same verse, up to about 350 words and cut at a sentence end. Headings are the note's first lemma.
